projects.title: rymo
projects.description: A local-first knowledge canvas inspired by Miro for arranging and connecting notes, links, and media offline. Its portable JSON board format uses a custom encoder and decoder for durable interoperability, while on-disk storage gives users direct ownership of their data without cloud infrastructure.

projects.title: Hack The Change 2024 | 2nd Place
projects.description: 2nd place at Hack The Change 2024 among 50+ teams. Built a mental health app with an LLM that classifies user journals by tone and theme, plus a content moderation filter to keep the community safe.

projects.title: Blog Website
projects.description: A modern, responsive blog template built with Next.js, MDX, and Tailwind CSS. This template includes a dark mode toggle, tag-based navigation, collections, search functionality, and more. I use this currently for my own blog!

projects.title: Social Discord Bot
projects.description: A bot made for Discord servers that listens for social media updates such as Tweets, going live on Twitch and Youtube posts. It can also post custom messages at a certain time of the day. There is also a voting system where users can react to the message to cast their votes.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: This site was made to display my projects and a short about me! (you're looking right at it!).

experiences.description: Independently architected and shipped a full-stack CRM and retail operations platform using React, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL, unifying analytics, marketing automation, and job orchestration. Integrated Dutchie, KayaPush, Resend, and Blackleaf APIs to synchronize customer, sales, labour, and messaging data and automate targeted SMS and email campaigns. Built C-suite analytics dashboards and granular RBAC with role-assigned permissions enforced across frontend routes and backend endpoints.

Developed full-stack C#/.NET and React features across a DDD-based microservice architecture for insurance workflows. Built a JavaScript rule sandbox that saves about eight staff hours per week and a Python-and-LLM knowledge base that accelerated rule development roughly fivefold while improving technical documentation sharing.

Delivered 30+ complex insurance rules in the company's proprietary JavaScript rules engine, increasing client product development speed by ~50%. Also built an internal documentation website covering API guides and reference material.

Developed custom websites, Discord bots, and scripts for 5+ clients serving 10,000+ users. Squashed 50+ critical bugs contributing to a 30% improvement in user satisfaction, and automated workflows reducing manual processing time by ~75%.

Architected Kotlin mobile GUI and core application logic to create smoother, more responsive user interactions, and developed a Node.js service that coordinated WebRTC signaling for reliable, low-latency peer-to-peer communication.
